title: radius: Update RFC dictionary files to FreeRADIUS 3.2.4
description:
Update the base dictionary and the various IANA and RFC dictionaries.
Expand a TLV (our parser doesn't handle TLVs in the same way as
FreeRADIUS's.)

Remove some attributes that are specified twice, generally those that
appeared in IANA drafts but haven't been published as RFC; originally they
were stuck at the bottom of the base dictionary, but later they
were moved to dictionary.iana (and occasionally published as RFCs.)

Add dictionary.rfc8045 and dictionary.rfc8559, though the former is
commented out because I'm not sure that TLVs inside extended
attributes work.

Handle the "vsa" type as octets in our parser, so we can avoid changing
the FreeRADIUS dictionary.

There's still a lot of vendor dictionaries, including new ones (and some
of those have Wireshark updates.)

Ping #15458

 #	composed of Attribute/Value Pairs.  The value of each attribute

-#                    [wireshark uses this type for non-standard 1-2-3 and 8 byte integers as well]

+#	ether   - 6 octets of hh:hh:hh:hh:hh:hh

+#	short   - 16-bit unsigned integer in network byte order
+#	signed  - 32-bit signed integer in network byte order

 #
 # 	FreeRADIUS uses a number of data types which are defined in
 #	RFC 6929.  These data types should NEVER be used in any other

commits_data.title: radius: Update RFC dictionary files to FreeRADIUS 3.2.4
commits_data.message:
radius: Update RFC dictionary files to FreeRADIUS 3.2.4

Update the base dictionary and the various IANA and RFC dictionaries.
Expand a TLV (our parser doesn't handle TLVs in the same way as
FreeRADIUS's.)

Remove some attributes that are specified twice, generally those that
appeared in IANA drafts but haven't been published as RFC; originally they
were stuck at the bottom of the base dictionary, but later they
were moved to dictionary.iana (and occasionally published as RFCs.)

Add dictionary.rfc8045 and dictionary.rfc8559, though the former is
commented out because I'm not sure that TLVs inside extended
attributes work.

Handle the "vsa" type as octets in our parser, so we can avoid changing
the FreeRADIUS dictionary.

There's still a lot of vendor dictionaries, including new ones (and some
of those have Wireshark updates.)

Ping #15458
